name: emmas_librarian
author: joaopedrov0
description: Emma's Librarian - A scientific library manager

scripts.electron:dev: npm run rebuild:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.test:k6: npm run rebuild:node && concurrently --kill-others --success first "node performance-tests/performance-harness.js" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 && k6 run performance-tests/load_tests.js"
scripts.test:performance:smoke: npm run rebuild:node && concurrently --kill-others --success first "node performance-tests/performance-harness.js" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 && k6 run -e TEST_TYPE=smoke performance-tests/load_tests.js"
scripts.test:performance:load: npm run rebuild:node && concurrently --kill-others --success first "node performance-tests/performance-harness.js" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 && k6 run -e TEST_TYPE=load performance-tests/load_tests.js"
scripts.test:performance:stress: npm run rebuild:node && concurrently --kill-others --success first "node performance-tests/performance-harness.js" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 && k6 run -e TEST_TYPE=stress performance-tests/load_tests.js"
scripts.test:performance:soak: npm run rebuild:node && concurrently --kill-others --success first "node performance-tests/performance-harness.js" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 && k6 run -e TEST_TYPE=soak performance-tests/load_tests.js"
scripts.test:playwright: npm run rebuild:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently --kill-others --success first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npx playwright test e2e-tests/ --config=playwright.config.js --workers=1"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:performance && npm run test:e2e
